forecasts.policyBasis: Canada overnight target rate, end of December 2027
forecasts.yieldBasis: Canada 5-year government bond, end of December 2027
forecasts.note: This is the June 24, 2026 forecast update. A later CIBC economics note checked on October 23, 2026 did not replace this table with a newer end-2027 overnight rate, so the June table is the figure shown, with its date.

The October 22, 2026 outlook says Desjardins expects a first Bank of Canada increase at the October 2026 decision and another in January 2027. It does not state the size of those increases, an end-2027 policy rate, or a 5-year yield.

The October 2026 monitor's quarterly path has the target at 2.50% in Q4 2026, 2.75% in Q1 2027, and 3.00% from Q2 2027 through Q4 2027. The spot column is dated October 13, 2026, with the target at 2.25%.
